long_biography.plain_text:
A lifelong sailor raised around his family's New Orleans restaurants, Pincus began building marine businesses before entering waterfront hospitality. He co-founded a sailing school and charter operation, and later developed Clipper City as a harbor-tour business. Graduate study in international transportation and maritime operations strengthened the practical experience he gained aboard racers, schooners, tankers and container ships.

Crew united that maritime background with restaurant operations. As co-founder and president, Pincus helped create Grand Banks, Pilot, Seaworthy, Island Oyster and other waterfront venues while adding marina management and Heritage Marine Works. His role centres on operations and vessel restoration; Alex contributes architecture and design. The brothers also acquired and are restoring historically significant sailing vessels through the group's preservation programme.
